name: kb_14_Normalized

schema.description: AllowedHostPath defines the host volume conditions that will be enabled by a policy for pods to use. It requires the path prefix to be defined.

pathPrefix.description:
pathPrefix is the path prefix that the host volume must match. It does not support `*`. Trailing slashes are trimmed when validating the path prefix with a host path.

Examples: `/foo` would allow `/foo`, `/foo/` and `/foo/bar` `/foo` would not allow `/food` or `/etc/foo`

readOnly.description: when set to true, will allow host volumes matching the pathPrefix only if all volume mounts are readOnly.

description: Please note that the policy now permits pods to use host volumes whose paths begin with **/var/log**. This prefix matches any directory under /var/log, including the base directory itself, while excluding any unrelated paths such as /var/logs or /etc/var/log. Furthermore, the policy requires that any volume mounts matching this prefix be configured as read‑only; attempts to mount these paths with write permissions will be denied.
